Since there is no evidence of malicious code execution—such as `curl | bash`, `eval`, or command substitution—in the top-level scope, sourcing this file for metadata extraction is safe.

While the `source` URLs point to GitHub and raw.githubusercontent.com, they align with the declared upstream (drhelius/Geartowns) and are consistent with typical AUR packaging practices. The checksums are provided and valid. No code is executed during `--printsrcinfo` that would result in data exfiltration or unauthorized network activity.
</details>
